bm_speaker.text: Bermuda's Parliament first met in 1620. It's one of the oldest in the Commonwealth.
The Speaker wears a wig and sits in a chair presented by the Parliament at Westminster. Debates are polite. It is a very small island.

bm_member.text: I represent a constituency of about a thousand people, most of whom I've also had lunch with.
On a small island you cannot say anything unkind about anyone without them being your cousin. It keeps debate honest.
